shortDescription: Manage FQDN Host Groups (System > Hosts & services > FQDN host group)

options.name: action
options.description: Indicates whether to add or remove hosts from the list, or replace the list entirely.

options.name: description
options.description: Description to be included on the FQDN Host Group object.

options.name: host_list
options.description: List of FQDN Host objects to be included in the FQDN Hostgroup

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the FQDN Host Group object to create, update, or delete

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(query) to retrieve, C(present) to create, C(absent) to remove, or C(updated) to modify
